author: DestructiveDonut
body:
Destructivedonut is the account.
"Team Griefing. (Taking 90+ iron blocks.)"
Ok the map was senex 1 and I decided to be a good guy and just casually mine iron at our side and I almost cleared the pile of iron out and then a guy named, "Eako," was like, ' DestructiveDonut what are you doing.  I don't remember what I said since I'm pretty stupid :P.
But I was in a call with 2 people and one of them was on the other team and I said, "lol im mining iron for the team cuz y not." and i said I was bored.  Idk not the best remembering skills.  And then my friend in the skype call yolo'ed it and ran to our side screwed everyone else and went for me and I tried running away but the knocked me into the void and I got a f11 glitch when you exit f11 when you're in the "You died" screen it wont let you respawn.   So I restarted minecraft and I went back on the server and I was banned.  . . . . .
First of all how is mining out iron team griefing.  Second of all there is ANOTHER SIDE OF IRON WITH 100+ BLOCKS OF IRON.  Third of all Eako said I killed my self with the iron blocks, but no my dipshit friend killed me.  
I don't get it :/
And yes I was ban evading, I wen't on my alt account and I complained to Eako on my alt.  I didn't know what ban evading was so when Eako told me I logged of.  
No this is my first time appealing a ban before, because the other bans I didn't really give a shit about. 
-DestructiveDonut

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

First of all, I told you numerous times that taking 90+ blocks was unneeded. You continued mining till you had around 100. You then got killed and all the iron blocks spilled into the void, giving your team a disadvantage. I only banned you for a couple hours, because I decided to be a little lenient.

Regards,
Excellence, Avicus Moderator

replies.body: You're contradicting yourself. You replied in chat more than once when I told you to stop. The definition of team griefing is putting your team in harm by doing things like taking a bunch of diamonds, iron, destroying benches, destroying defenses, etc.
